statement: Over a polynomial with N=d(n−d) distinct real projective roots, points of the Wronski fibre in Gr(d,n) can be labelled by standard tableaux of rectangle (n−d)^d. For endpoints whose roots have distinct absolute values, continuation along a generic real root path acts on these labels by the sliding operation of Definition 3.2, a jeu-de-taquin rule. Remark 3.7 describes the cyclic-root-loop action by sliding the smallest entry through the tableau to become the largest.

notes:
This describes the real-rooted monodromy groupoid, not a claim that the full complex monodromy group is symmetric. The theorem also treats skew shapes, with additional exclusions at 0 and infinity.
